name: dbscope
description: Lock and rewrite risk for PostgreSQL migrations, shown as you edit them.

commands.title: dbscope: Check migrations in this folder

dbscope.path.description: The dbscope binary: a name on PATH or an absolute path.

dbscope.migrations.description: Glob patterns for migration files. Saving one checks every migration in its folder, in order.

dbscope.schemaDump.description: A pg_dump --schema-only file to check against, relative to the workspace folder. Used when the DSN variable is not set.

dbscope.stats.description: A "dbscope stats export" file that adds table sizes to the schema dump.

dbscope.dsnEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the database URL. The URL itself is never stored in settings.

dbscope.checkOnSave.description: Check a migration's folder when a migration file is saved.
